meta.description: ColdFusion JVM argument security catalog. Every flag is sourced from the two Adobe JVM argument guides and carries the update it shipped in, whether it is a breaking change, and the values considered secure so the client can compute a weighted secure score.

scoring.method: score = round(sum(weight of security flags in secure state) / sum(weight of all security flags) * 100)
scoring.notes: A flag with a `secure` value takes its secure value from that field; otherwise the documented `default` is treated as the secure baseline. A flag that is not present in JVMArguments is evaluated at its documented default.

-Dcoldfusion.attachment.allowblockedexte.description: When false (default), attachments whose extensions are on the blocked list are rejected by cfexchange/cfpop/cfimap. Setting true accepts all attachment types and increases risk.
-Dcoldfusion.attachment.allowblockedexte.recommendation: Keep false unless a trusted workflow requires blocked extensions.

-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowResultDocume.description: Controls xsl:result-document in Saxon XSLT used by XMLSearch/XMLTransform. False (default) blocks stylesheets writing arbitrary files.
-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowResultDocume.recommendation: Keep false to prevent arbitrary file writes from stylesheets.

-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowUnparsedText.description: Controls the unparsed-text() family in Saxon XSLT. False (default) blocks stylesheets reading arbitrary server files.
-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowUnparsedText.recommendation: Keep false to prevent server-side file disclosure.

-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowDocFunction.description: Controls doc(), doc-available() and document() in Saxon XSLT. False (default) blocks loading external or server-side XML.
-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowDocFunction.recommendation: Keep false to prevent SSRF/file disclosure via stylesheets.

-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowEnvironmentV.description: Controls environment-variable() in Saxon XSLT. False (default) blocks stylesheets from reading host environment variables.
-Dcoldfusion.xml.saxon.allowEnvironmentV.recommendation: Keep false to prevent environment variable disclosure.

-Dcoldfusion.async.emptyfuture.blocking.description: Controls get() on incomplete empty futures from runAsync(). True (default) blocks per CompletableFuture semantics; false throws TaskNotCompletedException immediately (legacy behavior).

-Dcoldfusion.allow.restricted.exception..description: When false (default), engine-reserved exception types (Database, Security, Template, etc.) cannot be used in user cfthrow/throw(). True allows them and can mask engine errors.
-Dcoldfusion.allow.restricted.exception..recommendation: Keep false so reserved exception types stay engine-owned.

-Dcoldfusion.qoq.enforceOldBehaviour.description: Compatibility flag for Query of Queries GROUP BY. Enabled restores legacy GROUP BY behavior.

-Dcoldfusion.qoq.parallel.description: Enables parallel processing for Query of Queries. Disabling restores the older non-parallel behavior.

-Dcoldfusion.qoq.parallel.threshold.description: Row-count threshold above which Query of Queries parallelization is applied. Default 10000.

-Dcoldfusion.mongodb.returnIdAsString.description: True (default) returns MongoDB _id as a plain string; false returns a CFMongoObjectID wrapper required for native ObjectId interop.

-Dcoldfusion.administrator.inputlengthfi.description: Increases the maximum input length accepted by the Administrator/Admin API (e.g. 65536 for large SAML XML). Raising this weakens an input-size guard, so only increase when required.

-Dcoldfusion.websocket.selector.validati.description: Enables WebSocket selector deny-list validation. True (default) ensures selector expressions cannot carry dangerous ColdFusion commands.
-Dcoldfusion.websocket.selector.validati.recommendation: Keep true so selector expressions stay logical-only.

-Dcoldfusion.deserialization.safeguard.e.description: Default-deny Java deserialization safeguard: only classes required by ColdFusion or allow-listed in serialfilter.txt are permitted. False reverts to the vulnerable legacy behavior.
-Dcoldfusion.deserialization.safeguard.e.recommendation: Keep true. Disabling re-opens deserialization RCE vectors.

-Dcoldfusion.pdf.ddx.allowExternalEntiti.description: Controls external XML entity resolution in DDX files processed by cfpdf action=processddx. False (default) blocks external entities (XXE).
-Dcoldfusion.pdf.ddx.allowExternalEntiti.recommendation: Keep false to prevent XXE via DDX.

-Dcoldfusion.datasource.allowed.properti.description: All risky datasource connection-string properties are blocked by default. This flag allow-lists specific ones (allowLoadLocalInfile, allowUrlInLocalInfile, autoDeserialize). Any value here re-enables a dangerous property.
-Dcoldfusion.datasource.allowed.properti.recommendation: Leave unset. Allow-listing autoDeserialize / local infile enables data exfiltration and RCE vectors.

-Dcoldfusion.xml.allowExternalEntities.description: Controls external entity resolution during XML parsing. False (default) prevents XML External Entity (XXE) file disclosure and denial-of-service attacks.
-Dcoldfusion.xml.allowExternalEntities.recommendation: Keep false. Setting true exposes blind XXE.

-Dcoldfusion.runtime.remotemethod.matchA.description: True (default) enforces strict argument matching on remote CFC methods: only declared arguments are accepted. False allows extra/undeclared arguments.
-Dcoldfusion.runtime.remotemethod.matchA.recommendation: Keep true to preserve remote method integrity.

-Dcoldfusion.systemprobe.allowexecution.description: False (default) prevents a System Probe from executing during a failure. True enables probe execution.
-Dcoldfusion.systemprobe.allowexecution.recommendation: Keep false unless actively diagnosing a failure.

-Dcoldfusion.pdfg.connectionTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for PDF conversion; conversions exceeding it are timed out with an exception.

-Dcoldfusion.datasource.blocked.properti.description: Legacy block-list for datasource connection-string properties (allowLoadLocalInfile, allowUrlInLocalInfile, autoDeserialize). NOTE: this flag does not work after ColdFusion 2025 Update 5 - use -Dcoldfusion.datasource.allowed.properties instead.

-Dcoldfusion.compiler.block.bytecode.description: True (default) prevents ColdFusion from executing pre-compiled CFML (Java bytecode) at runtime, blocking a common code-execution vector.
-Dcoldfusion.compiler.block.bytecode.recommendation: Keep true. Disabling allows attacker-supplied bytecode to run.

-Dcoldfusion.encryption.useCFMX_COMPATAs.description: Removed in ColdFusion 2025. Previously forced the weak CFMX_COMPAT algorithm as the default for seven encryption functions.

-Dcoldfusion.searchimplicitscopes.description: Controls searching implicit scopes (variables, arguments, form, URL, ...) for un-scoped variables. Adobe recommends false for proper security enforcement; the flag is scheduled for removal.
-Dcoldfusion.searchimplicitscopes.recommendation: Set false so ColdFusion does not auto-search implicit scopes.

-Dcfdocument.metahttpequivrefresh.localf.description: Affects how cfdocument handles the HTML meta refresh directive for local files. Allowing the URL/location in the meta tag can be abused, so blocking it (false) is safer.
-Dcfdocument.metahttpequivrefresh.localf.recommendation: Set false and sanity-check any URL before allowing meta refresh.

-Djdk.lang.Process.allowAmbiguousCommand.description: Controls how Java parses ambiguous command lines on Windows. False (default) is the safer behavior.
-Djdk.lang.Process.allowAmbiguousCommand.recommendation: Keep false to avoid ambiguous command parsing on Windows.

-Dcoldfusion.sessioncookie.httponly.description: Determines whether session cookies are hidden from client-side JavaScript. True sets HttpOnly and mitigates cookie theft via XSS.
-Dcoldfusion.sessioncookie.httponly.recommendation: Set true so session cookies are HttpOnly.

-Dcoldfusion.xml.allowPathCharacters.description: Controls whether XML parsing allows path characters (/, \, :) in element names, attributes or values.

-Duser.timezone=<timezone>.description: Sets the ColdFusion host time zone, e.g. -Duser.timezone=GMT for UTC.

-Dfile.encoding.description: Sets the encoding of ColdFusion files (.cfc/.cfm).

-Dcoldfusion.monitoring.id.reset.description: Controls whether the PMT monitoring ID is reset when the server starts. Resetting on restart is the more secure choice.

-Dcoldfusion.number.allowdotsuffix.description: If false, an operand with a trailing dot is evaluated as a string.

-Djdk.tls.client.protocols.description: TLS protocols used by TLS/SSL clients. Restricting to TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3 avoids legacy, insecure protocols.
-Djdk.tls.client.protocols.recommendation: Keep to TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3; do not add TLSv1/TLSv1.1/SSLv3.

-Dhttps.protocols.description: TLS protocols used by HTTPS connections in ColdFusion.
-Dhttps.protocols.recommendation: Keep to TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3; do not re-enable legacy protocols.

-Dcoldfusion.sftp.enable-ssh-rsa.description: Enables the legacy ssh-rsa algorithm for sFTP. False (default) keeps the weaker algorithm disabled.
-Dcoldfusion.sftp.enable-ssh-rsa.recommendation: Keep false unless a legacy sFTP peer requires ssh-rsa.

-Dcoldfusion.sftp.fingerprint.description: Fingerprint algorithm for sFTP. SHA256 (default) is stronger than md5.

-Dcoldfusion.application.orderby.caseins.description: Determines whether string columns are ordered case-insensitively by ORDER BY like traditional databases.

-Dcoldfusion.jdbc.mysql.datetime.str.description: If true, converts MySQL datetime objects to strings.

-Dcoldfusion.jdbc.mssql.multi_resultset..description: Controls resultset parsing behavior for SQL Server ResultSets.

-Dorg.osgi.framework.bootdelegation.description: Enables scheduled tasks to run in a Docker image.

-Dcoldfusion.orderedstruct.size.description: Sets the initial size of ordered structs.

-Dcoldfusion.http.usepooling.description: Controls whether outbound HTTP connections are pooled and reused.
